tests.title: Clean installation
tests.procedure: Build from a clean isolated workspace, migrate an empty MySQL database and start the app.
tests.expected_result: Documented setup works without hidden local files.

tests.title: Demo profile isolation
tests.procedure: Start normal and demo profiles against isolated databases.
tests.expected_result: Known demo users exist only when demo setup is explicitly selected.

tests.title: Authentication and password storage
tests.procedure: Try correct/incorrect credentials and inspect fixture password storage.
tests.expected_result: Valid account authenticates; invalid credentials fail; plaintext passwords are absent.

tests.title: CSRF enforcement
tests.procedure: Run login and mutations with valid, missing and invalid CSRF tokens.
tests.expected_result: Valid flow works; missing/invalid tokens do not mutate data.

tests.title: Role enforcement
tests.procedure: Call all instructor mutations as a student and protected routes anonymously.
tests.expected_result: Server denies access without relying on hidden UI controls.

tests.title: Instructor ownership
tests.procedure: Use instructor B to access/change instructor A exam, results, events and recovery.
tests.expected_result: No cross-instructor read/write or recovery is allowed.

tests.title: Draft authoring
tests.procedure: Create, read, update and delete owned draft questions/exams using real MySQL.
tests.expected_result: CRUD persists correct values and validates malformed fields.

tests.title: Publish validation
tests.procedure: Publish empty papers, invalid options/keys/marks/windows, then a valid paper.
tests.expected_result: Invalid drafts stay draft; the valid paper publishes atomically.

tests.title: Publish/edit race and freeze
tests.procedure: Race publication with edits; then attempt all published mutations.
tests.expected_result: No partial paper publishes and no published content/timing/key changes.

tests.title: Exam catalog and availability
tests.procedure: List as student and attempt starts before opening, during window and at closing.
tests.expected_result: Drafts/keys stay hidden; only the valid window permits a new start.

tests.title: Repeated and concurrent starts
tests.procedure: Start the same exam concurrently with distinct connections for one student.
tests.expected_result: One attempt row exists; returned IDs and original deadline agree.

tests.title: Student payload confidentiality
tests.procedure: Inspect student HTML and all API payloads throughout an attempt/result.
tests.expected_result: No answer keys, correct flags, password hashes or other-user data appear.

tests.title: Save/clear and relationship validation
tests.procedure: Save, clear and reload answers; submit foreign question/option IDs.
tests.expected_result: Valid choices persist; null clears; foreign relationships fail.

tests.title: Stale and reordered saves
tests.procedure: Send old expected revisions after newer saved selections, including two tabs.
tests.expected_result: Stale writes conflict and cannot overwrite the newer accepted answer.

tests.title: Refresh and client-clock tampering
tests.procedure: Save, refresh, change displayed client time and resume.
tests.expected_result: Server-confirmed selections and original deadline remain authoritative.

tests.title: Deadline boundaries
tests.procedure: Test before, exactly at and after deadline including lock wait crossing deadline.
tests.expected_result: Only pre-deadline authoritative checks accept answers; no extra time is granted.

tests.title: Independent scoring fixtures
tests.procedure: Grade all-correct, mixed, all-wrong, unanswered and cleared fixtures.
tests.expected_result: Persisted totals match independent hand calculations; client score fields are ignored.

tests.title: Repeated submit
tests.procedure: Submit twice and repeat after a simulated lost response.
tests.expected_result: Same immutable terminal state and result return without duplicate grading.

tests.title: Save/submit/timeout races
tests.procedure: Race independent save, submit and expiry transactions using a barrier.
tests.expected_result: One valid final state/score persists; no answer changes after finalization.

tests.title: Closed browser timeout
tests.procedure: Close the browser without submitting and wait through controlled server expiry.
tests.expected_result: Server finalizes saved answers without a browser callback.

tests.title: Restart and overdue recovery
tests.procedure: Restart the app with live and overdue persisted attempts.
tests.expected_result: Answers/results remain; original deadlines remain; overdue attempts finalize.

tests.title: Duplicate login policy
tests.procedure: Use sequential and near-simultaneous logins from separate browser sessions.
tests.expected_result: Only one student session succeeds; rejected login does not invalidate the first.

tests.title: Supervised session recovery
tests.procedure: Owning instructor resets a current lost-session attempt; also try historic/terminal and cross-instructor active-attempt resets, plus concurrent reset/login.
tests.expected_result: Only scoped current recovery succeeds under the per-student lock; old session fails, same answers/deadline resume, and event is audited. Historic/cross-owner recovery is denied.

tests.title: Student record isolation
tests.procedure: Student B requests student A attempt, answer mutation and result.
tests.expected_result: All cross-student access is denied without data disclosure.

tests.title: Event scoping and quality
tests.procedure: Generate denied-login and recovery events then query as both instructors/student.
tests.expected_result: Only authorized relevant events are visible; metadata contains no credentials/tokens.

tests.title: Database failure and rollback
tests.procedure: Force a test write/commit failure inside save and finalization.
tests.expected_result: No false saved/success message or partial final result; retry can recover.

tests.title: Complete real browser journey
tests.procedure: Instructor creates/publishes; student logs in, saves, refreshes, submits; instructor reviews.
tests.expected_result: All screens use real APIs/MySQL and independently expected score appears.

tests.title: Keyboard and responsive UI
tests.procedure: Use keyboard-only navigation and inspect approximately 360px and desktop layouts.
tests.expected_result: Controls are labeled/reachable, focus visible, and exam content is not clipped.

tests.title: Offline/pending-save feedback
tests.procedure: Fail a save, disconnect, retry before expiry and attempt submit with pending work.
tests.expected_result: UI distinguishes pending/failed/saved; no silent answer loss or post-expiry acceptance.

tests.title: Safe text and SQL handling
tests.procedure: Use HTML/script-like question text and SQL-like login/form input in disposable fixtures.
tests.expected_result: Input is treated as data; no script execution or SQL injection occurs.

tests.title: Logout and session fixation
tests.procedure: Compare pre/post-login session and CSRF state; logout; simulate idle session expiry with no attempt and subsequent login.
tests.expected_result: Session fixation and logout are protected; refreshed CSRF flow works; inactive registry cleanup permits pre-attempt lost-cookie recovery after the documented timeout.

tests.title: Backup/restore rehearsal
tests.procedure: Back up a disposable demo DB and restore to a separate disposable DB.
tests.expected_result: Exam records, answers and scores match; no normal database is reset.

tests.title: Ten-student pilot
tests.procedure: Run about ten distinct student accounts concurrently and reconcile saved answers/results.
tests.expected_result: All acknowledged writes and scores are accounted for; actual conditions/timings recorded.

tests.title: Documentation run-through
tests.procedure: Follow README, provisioning, demo, recovery and troubleshooting instructions from scratch.
tests.expected_result: Paths, commands, URLs and expected behavior match the actual build.

tests.title: Secrets and safe errors
tests.procedure: Inspect tracked files, sanitized runtime logs and deliberately failed requests.
tests.expected_result: No real secrets, raw session tokens, SQL traces or known demo credentials in normal config.

tests.title: User provisioning
tests.procedure: Use the documented local provisioning flow, duplicate names and invalid roles.
tests.expected_result: Accounts persist with encoded passwords; untrusted input cannot grant instructor rights.

tests.title: Required tests actually execute
tests.procedure: Inspect Maven/Playwright reports, configured suite selections, profiles and test counts on a real run.
tests.expected_result: All configured Java/HTTP/MySQL/browser checks selected for the run actually execute; skipped/zero-test success or missing MySQL cannot satisfy that run. Separate manual/setup checks retain their own status.

tests.title: Release package startup
tests.procedure: Build the release artifact and run it using the documented configuration.
tests.expected_result: Packaged application starts and the smoke workflow succeeds.

tests.title: No dead UI actions or console errors
tests.procedure: Exercise all required screen actions and inspect browser console/network failures.
tests.expected_result: No dummy actions, fake success or unhandled errors remain.

tests.title: Bounded login throttling
tests.procedure: Trigger configured login throttling, then verify documented recovery behavior.
tests.expected_result: Repeated failures are bounded; normal permitted users can recover without bypassing auth.
